title: The Role and Transcriptional Regulatory Mechanism of Rice OsGSTF5 in the Metabolism of Pretilachlor under Fenclorim Induction.
authors: Zuo, Yao; Ding, Bowen; Yan, Yujie; Luo, Zi; Hu, Dan; Hu, Lifeng
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水稻OsGSTF5在除草剂安全剂诱导下的代谢功能，并通过酵母单杂交和双荧光素酶实验鉴定四个转录因子结合其启动子，涉及TF-DNA结合验证但以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟方法仅限分子对接，深度有限。
abstract: Fenclorim (Fen), an herbicide safener, mitigates pretilachlor (Pre)-induced phytotoxicity in rice, although its molecular mechanism remains unclear. Previous studies have shown that Fen significantly induces OsGSTF5 expression. This study revealed via molecular docking and in vitro assays that the OsGSTF5 protein binds to and metabolizes Pre. Unlike the wild-type plants, the OsGSTF5-overexpressing lines presented Pre tolerance. Cloning the OsGSTF5 promoter (2.0 kb) identified a Fen-responsive cis-element (-1100 to -1500 bp). Yeast one-hybrid screening revealed that four transcription factors (EIL, AP2/ERF, DBB, and C2H2 families) bind the promoter, as validated by dual-luciferase and qRT-PCR assays. The research results establish a Fen (safener)-mediated detoxification network with OsGSTF5 as the core, promoting our understanding of herbicide action mechanisms. Additionally, for the first time, this study clarifies the inductive regulatory mechanism of safeners in rice.
abstract_zh: Fenclorim（Fen）作为一种除草剂安全剂，可减轻pretilachlor（Pre）对水稻的植物毒性，但其分子机制尚不清楚。已有研究表明，Fen显著诱导OsGSTF5表达。本研究通过分子对接和体外实验揭示，OsGSTF5蛋白能够结合并代谢Pre。与野生型植株相比，OsGSTF5过表达株系表现出对Pre的耐受性。克隆OsGSTF5启动子（2.0 kb）鉴定出一个响应Fen的顺式作用元件（-1100至-1500 bp）。酵母单杂交筛选显示，四个转录因子（EIL、AP2/ERF、DBB和C2H2家族）与该启动子结合，并通过双荧光素酶和qRT-PCR实验得到验证。研究结果建立了以OsGSTF5为核心的Fen（安全剂）介导的解毒网络，促进了我们对除草剂作用机制的理解。此外，本研究首次阐明了安全剂在水稻中的诱导调控机制。
